Google DeepMind AI CEO Demis Hassabis has just announced $2.1 billion to cure all diseases with AI in research.

Demis Hassabis has been building AI for years that folds proteins, designs molecules, and accelerates drug discovery (which earned him the Nobel Prize along the way).

tweets.author: uxtigersdotcom
tweets.text:
